notes.subject: kot
notes.rationale: משפט i min kot / pasin bilong skelim, D2 — 'em i wokim kot' i holim pasin bilong skelim long ol i no gat wanpela long lukautim ol.

notes.subject: לתת לו
notes.rationale: Ol tanim tok i ritim 'in giving him' — infinitive i tok olsem holim wanem kain laik bilong גר; mi tanim olsem 'bilong givim long em' olsem ylt.

translation: Em i wokim kot bilong ol pikinini i no gat papa na ol meri i no gat man, na em i laikim ⟨את⟩ man i kamap long narapela ples, bilong givim long em bret na klos.

tokens.gloss: na meri i no gat man
man i kamap long narapela ples
